text:
mira: FYI rolled the strict fncall validator to 10% canary in eu-west and we're seeing a cluster of rejects for `search_tool` related to `result.items` being null instead of an empty array.
devon: digging reject spike ~2.8% on canary slice. sample shows apps returning `result: null` when no hits.
anya: hm, our schema insists `result.items: []`. Is that a bug in clients or did we tighten the contract unexpectedly?
devon: looks like a mix. some older clients still rely on null semantics. here's a log sample we pulled:

```
{"validator":"fncall_v3_strict","tool":"search_tool","reason":"missing field 'result.items'","req":"r-23b"}
```
mira: we shouldn't break callers w/o coordination. prefer nonbreaking path while we audit.
sam: options: (A) make validator permissive for just `search_tool` (fast), (B) keep strict but fallback route that coerces `result=null`->`result.items=[]` (safer for UX).
anya: UI/console needs a quick toggle to mark the tool as tolerant and to surface sampled payloads. Product owners will want this control.
devon: telemetry plan: emit metric `fncall.validator.rejects_by_tool` with tag `reason=missing_result_items` and `coercion_candidate=true`. also add `validator_action` tag values: reject|soft_accept|coerce.
mira: billing concern: if we soft_accept/coerce we still bill tokens. need to decide if we attribute to main route or fallback for chargeback.
sam: agree. we should tag route_id and `billing_path:coercion` if coerced, so finance can filter.
anya: console change: add quick filter "fncall schema rejects" + sampled payload list and a soft-accept toggle at tool-level. I'll ship a small patch.
devon: operational plan: revert canary to permissive for `search_tool` in eu-west and enable soft_accept sampling (sample last 200 rejects to S3). I'll do the rollback now.
mira: freeze any further validator rollouts until we finish a one-week audit and owners verify clients.
sam: I'm oncall for next 8h if this causes any increased error noise.
deploy-bot: canary-update: strict-fncall-validator -> 10% -> initiated 2026-03-20T09:17:00Z
mira: thanks. after rollback, create an incident note with affected request_ids and owners, then we can schedule a coordinated breaking change with client outreach.
devon: starting permissive push and sampling. will tag events with `validator_action=soft_accept`.
anya: console ticket created: /console/alerts?query=fncall.validator.rejects+tool:search_tool
mira: closing thread here, keep the incident doc updated and ping #incidents if we see regressions. :thumbsup:
